name: disable_script_object_push

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_DisableScriptObjectPush does not access or change the Script value stack

notes: ScriptCommand_DisableScriptObjectPush queues operation type 0x26 for the object ID stored at Script offset 0. Type 0x26 maps to the embedded PUSH_OFF name, and its dispatcher sets the push-disable flag 0x200000. The JP corpus contains 137 calls; 58 immediately follow command 105 disable_selected_object_background_collision, while 93 are immediately followed by command 57 disable_selected_object_motion.
